name: Music-Chart Mid-Week Edge
thesis: Billboard #1 is knowable from free public data days before Kalshi books close (Sun 23:59 ET) and stan-retail books lag it.
why_killed: The free reproducible signal and the market lag are mutually exclusive across the two series: where the free signal is strong (albums, HITS 100%) the market is already at ~$1.00 with no size; where the market lags (songs, real gaps+volume) the free reproducible signal (kworb Spotify) is only 50-60% accurate because the Hot 100 is multi-metric (radio+sales+streams). Trading the free signal loses ~3c/ct.

timing_model.chart_sat: Billboard chart date (Saturday, encoded in event ticker)
timing_model.book_close: Sun chart_sat-6 23:59 ET (validated vs live close_time)

fill_model: entry=yes_ask.close_dollars at decision hour; fillable size capped at that hour's volume_fp; pnl/ct = settlement_value(signal_leader) - entry - taker_fee
trigger: (1.0 - ask) > taker_fee + 0.03; trade the free-data SIGNAL LEADER (ex-ante), not the ex-post winner

signal_sources.albums: HITS Daily Double Midweek 20 album chart, dated archives /charts/midweek-20/<Thursday>, ranked by Activity (Billboard-200 consumption units)
signal_sources.songs: kworb.net US Spotify daily via Wayback Machine (curl), ranked by 7-day stream column
signal_sources.totc: Talk of the Charts self-audit cited as source claim only; NOT re-graded (X posts unfetchable); its 52/52 not laundered into a verified number

pickover_live_2026-07-24: 26AUG01 favourites (Choosin' Texas, Daughter From Hell) bid 0.99 with NO resting ask; cannot buy the discount

forward_log.purpose: prospective KILL re-check + decay/pick-over detector; captures HITS+kworb leader/margin and live Kalshi ask on leader & favourite
forward_log.revisit_condition: only if a ToTC-based (multi-metric) signal, logged from timestamped originals, proves both accurate AND ahead of a lagging, size-carrying Kalshi ask
